zh: 位置 i 的区域向左右延伸，只会被严格更高的高度挡住；相等的高度仍然允许它是最大值，所以可以越过。
区域的左边界是左侧最近的严格更高位置，右边界是右侧最近的严格更高位置，长度为二者下标之差减一。这两个最近更高位置都能用单调栈在线性时间求出。
从左往右维护单调栈：弹出所有高度不超过当前值的下标，栈顶（若有）就是左侧最近严格更高位置，否则记为 -1，再把当前下标入栈；从右往左同样做一遍，没有时记为 n。把每个位置的 右边界 - 左边界 - 1 累加，用 64 位整数输出。
en: The region of position i extends left and right and is blocked only by a strictly higher height; equal heights still let it be the maximum, so the region passes over them.

The region's left boundary is the nearest strictly higher position on the left and its right boundary the nearest strictly higher position on the right; its length is the difference of those indices minus one. Both nearest higher positions can be found in linear time with monotonic stacks.

Scan left to right with a monotonic stack: pop every index whose height is not greater than the current one; the top, if any, is the nearest strictly higher position on the left, otherwise use -1; then push the current index. Do the same from right to left, using n when there is none. Sum right minus left minus 1 over all positions in a 64-bit integer and print it.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Use monotonic stacks to find the nearest strictly higher heights on the left and on the right.

## Proof of correctness

A valid interval cannot cross a higher position; inside the two boundaries the current value is the maximum throughout, so that whole interval is the longest.

## Complexity

O(n) time, O(n) space.
